title: Use gpt-6-luna for every OpenAI language model call
description: Ryan's rule (2026-11-02): all LLM calls use GPT 6 Luna. Moves web_transform MODEL, topic-modeling and html-structured and reinforcement-memory defaults, shipped configurations and docs off gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-4o-mini. Speech-to-text audio models are not language models and stay.
